verdict.rationale: Bento is an observability SaaS, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only a CLI, SDK docs, an llms.txt file and docs served over MCP, none of which is an interactive API explorer with runnable examples. The OpenAPI probes at all candidate paths returned 404, and CLI command examples are an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
